news.headline: Discovered Materials is playing AI whack-a-mole to hunt cooler chips
news.summary: Discovered Materials just closed a $9M round to hunt for novel materials that could make chips more efficient—leaning on AI to speed up the material discovery process and stay ahead of the semiconductor curve.

news.headline: Strategy Sells $109M in Bitcoin as Dollar Reserve Tops $4.6B
news.summary: Strategy offloaded $109M in Bitcoin to fund a massive buyback of its own shares—part of a broader $654M capital return to shareholders. The move underscores how some companies are deploying crypto holdings as liquid assets for corporate finance.

educational.title: Index Funds vs. Picking Individual Stocks
points: An index fund buys a whole market segment at once — instant diversification
Most professional stock-pickers underperform simple index funds over time
Individual stocks can outperform, but concentrate your risk in one company
Index investing trades excitement for consistency and much lower fees
A common approach: index funds as the base, individual picks as a smaller side bet
